title: InterpretCognates: Interactive Probing and Cross-Linguistic Geometric Norms for Multilingual Neural Translation (NLLB-200)
description: Open-source interactive web platform, 135-language embedding norm suite, and deterministic statistical verification pipeline for probing universal conceptual structure, phylogenetic signal (ASJP), cross-linguistic colexification (CLICS^3), and bilingual lexical geometry in Meta's NLLB-200 neural translation model.

creators.name: Mathewson, Kyle E.
creators.affiliation: Department of Psychology and Neuroscience and Mental Health Institute, University of Alberta
